tasks.label: Account health & red flags
tasks.blurb: Structural sweep: keyword sprawl, missing negatives, naming, automation-without-data, PMax brand cannibalization, disapprovals.

tasks.label: Budget & pacing
tasks.blurb: MTD spend vs goal, 20% scale rule, 3x kill rule, account MER. Emits the md+html+xlsx bundle plus change tables.

tasks.label: Bidding strategy
tasks.blurb: Manual vs automated fit, Target CPA/ROAS, data-maturity score, learning-phase health, automated-bidding failure diagnosis.

tasks.label: Keywords & search terms
tasks.blurb: Search-query report audit, three-tier negatives, add-keyword finds, and the two-block waste filter (md+html+xlsx + Editor CSVs).

tasks.label: Quality Score forensics
tasks.blurb: 6-step QS diagnosis when QS<5 or CPCs rise: search-term CTR, device split, ad relevance matrix, low-CTR pause, A/B setup.

tasks.label: Audiences & remarketing
tasks.blurb: Three-tier remarketing + bid adjustments, first-party readiness (Customer Match, Enhanced Conversions, Consent Mode), PMax signals.

tasks.label: Conversions & tracking
tasks.blurb: Weekly conversion health, primary actions/counting/attribution, CVR-drop diagnosis, automation-readiness check.

tasks.label: Performance reporting
tasks.blurb: Daily visibility glance or the monthly client report (spend, conversions, revenue, ROAS, top/bottom campaigns).

tasks.label: Competitive analysis
tasks.blurb: Weekly impression-share erosion, rising CPCs / auction pressure, rank vs budget lost IS. Hands off Auction Insights to a manual pull.

tasks.label: PMax campaigns (14-day momentum)
tasks.blurb: Scale vs cut/investigate by comparing the last 14 days to the previous 14. Emits md+html (ROAS sliders)+xlsx.

tasks.label: PMax listing groups
tasks.blurb: Per-partition / per-product waste, campaign-benchmarked two-block filter (tunable expensiveness factor). Emits md+html+xlsx.

tasks.label: Product performance
tasks.blurb: Zombie / surging / declining products across Shopping + PMax over 30d and two 14d windows. Emits md+html+xlsx + worklists.

tasks.label: Full account audit
tasks.blurb: Point-in-time 9-step account audit plus modern checks (PMax, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions, Demand Gen). Emits an 18-tab xlsx.

tasks.label: CM3 by product
tasks.blurb: Per-product contribution-margin report from a Shopping CSV (optional Shopify gross-profit CSV). Emits md+html+xlsx; pptx deck opt-in.
